title: RAG — Retrieval-Augmented Generation
excerpt: Give an LLM access to a searchable knowledge base and it stops hallucinating facts. The architecture behind every 'chat with your docs' product.

source.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks (NeurIPS 2020)

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
excerpt: Asking an LLM to 'think step by step' doesn't just feel more intelligent — it measurably improves accuracy on math, logic, and reasoning benchmarks.

source.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models (NeurIPS 2022)

title: LoRA — Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
excerpt: Fine-tune a 175B-parameter model by training just 0.01% of the weights. The technique that made personal LLM fine-tuning practical.

source.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models (ICLR 2022)

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
excerpt: The paper behind Stable Diffusion, DALL·E 2, and Midjourney. Turn noise into images by learning to reverse a gradual corruption process.

title: Adam — Adaptive Moment Estimation
excerpt: The optimizer that quietly powers most deep learning models. Combines momentum and per-parameter learning rates in one elegant update rule.

source.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization (ICLR 2015)

title: Word2Vec — Efficient Word Representations
excerpt: The paper that made 'king - man + woman ≈ queen' a real thing, and gave NLP its first widely-used dense embeddings.

source.title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space (ICLR 2013)

title: YOLO — You Only Look Once
excerpt: Reformulating object detection as a single regression problem made real-time detection practical. 45 FPS on a GPU, with one forward pass.

source.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection (CVPR 2016)

title: GPT-3 — Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
excerpt: The paper that showed scaling alone turns a language model into a few-shot learner — no fine-tuning required. Prompt engineering as we know it started here.

title: ReAct — Reasoning + Acting for LLM Agents
excerpt: The paper that showed LLMs could interleave chain-of-thought with tool calls, laying the groundwork for every modern AI agent framework including Claude Code and n8n AI nodes.

source.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (ICLR 2023)

title: ResNet — Deep Residual Learning
excerpt: Skip connections made it possible to train 150+ layer networks without the vanishing gradient problem, winning ImageNet 2015.

source.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition (CVPR 2016)

title: AlexNet — The Paper That Started the Deep Learning Boom
excerpt: The 2012 ImageNet-winning CNN that halved the error rate overnight and put GPU-trained deep nets on the map.

source.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (NeurIPS 2012)

title: BERT — Bidirectional Pre-training for Language Understanding
excerpt: How masked language modeling and next-sentence prediction unlocked transfer learning for NLP and powered a whole generation of classifiers.

source.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding (NAACL 2019)

title: Attention Is All You Need — The Transformer
excerpt: The 2017 paper that replaced recurrence with self-attention and became the foundation of every modern LLM including BERT, GPT, and Gemini.
